------------------------CRM_FINANCIAL---------------------------------

WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(NUMERIC(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(ANNUAL_BUDGET) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_BUDGET) end),0) ANNUAL_BUDGET_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(BUSINESS_ASSETS) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),BUSINESS_ASSETS) end),0)  BUSINESS_ASSETS_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(CUST_NET_WORTH) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUST_NET_WORTH) end),0)  CUST_NET_WORTH_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK) end),0)  DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(INVEST_SHARES_UNITS) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),INVEST_SHARES_UNITS) end),0)  INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE) end),0)  OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(PROPERTY) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),PROPERTY) end),0)  PROPERTY_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT) end),0)  TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD) end),0)  TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(AMOUNT1) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT1) end),0)  AMOUNT1_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(AMOUNT2) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT2) end),0)  AMOUNT2_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(AMOUNT3) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT3) end),0)  AMOUNT3_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(AMOUNT4) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT4) end),0)  AMOUNT4_tgt
, isnull(sum(case when ISNUMERIC(AMOUNT5) = 0 then 0 else convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT5) end),0)  AMOUNT5_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_FINANCIAL WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)

,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
 , ANNUAL_BUDGET ANNUAL_BUDGET_src
 , BUSINESS_ASSETS BUSINESS_ASSETS_src
 , CUST_NET_WORTH CUST_NET_WORTH_src
 , DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_src
 , INVEST_SHARES_UNITS INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_src
 , OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src
 , PROPERTY PROPERTY_src
 , TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_src
 , TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_src
 , AMOUNT1 AMOUNT1_src
 , AMOUNT2 AMOUNT2_src
 , AMOUNT3 AMOUNT3_src
 , AMOUNT4 AMOUNT4_src
 , AMOUNT5 AMOUNT5_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_FINANCIAL WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, ANNUAL_BUDGET_tgt
, BUSINESS_ASSETS_tgt
, CUST_NET_WORTH_tgt
, DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_tgt
, INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_tgt
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt
, PROPERTY_tgt
, TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_tgt
, TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_tgt
,AMOUNT1_tgt
,AMOUNT2_tgt
,AMOUNT3_tgt
,AMOUNT4_tgt
,AMOUNT5_tgt
, ANNUAL_BUDGET_src
, BUSINESS_ASSETS_src
, CUST_NET_WORTH_src
, DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_src
, INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_src
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src
, PROPERTY_src
, TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_src
, TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_src
,AMOUNT1_src
,AMOUNT2_src
,AMOUNT3_src
,AMOUNT4_src
,AMOUNT5_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
 CAST(COUNT_SRC  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ANNUAL_BUDGET_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ANNUAL_BUDGET_tgt
,CAST(BUSINESS_ASSETS_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) BUSINESS_ASSETS_tgt
,CAST(CUST_NET_WORTH_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_NET_WORTH_tgt
,CAST(DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_tgt
,CAST(INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_tgt
,CAST(OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt
,CAST(PROPERTY_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PROPERTY_tgt
,CAST(TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_tgt
,CAST(TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT1_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT1_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT2_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT2_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT3_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT3_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT4_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT4_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT5_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT5_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_BUDGET_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ANNUAL_BUDGET_src
,CAST(BUSINESS_ASSETS_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) BUSINESS_ASSETS_src
,CAST(CUST_NET_WORTH_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_NET_WORTH_src
,CAST(DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_src
,CAST(INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_src
,CAST(OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src
,CAST(PROPERTY_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PROPERTY_src
,CAST(TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_src
,CAST(TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_src
,CAST(AMOUNT1_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT1_src
,CAST(AMOUNT2_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT2_src
,CAST(AMOUNT3_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT3_src
,CAST(AMOUNT4_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT4_src
,CAST(AMOUNT5_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT5_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,DATE
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, ANNUAL_BUDGET_src
, BUSINESS_ASSETS_src
, CUST_NET_WORTH_src
, DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_src
, INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_src
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src
, PROPERTY_src
, TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_src
, TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_src
,AMOUNT1_src
,AMOUNT2_src
,AMOUNT3_src
,AMOUNT4_src
,AMOUNT5_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, ANNUAL_BUDGET_tgt
, BUSINESS_ASSETS_tgt
, CUST_NET_WORTH_tgt
, DEPOSITS_OTHER_BANK_tgt
, INVEST_SHARES_UNITS_tgt
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt
, PROPERTY_tgt
, TOT_SHARE_INVESTMENT_tgt
, TOTAL_AMOUNT_HELD_tgt
,AMOUNT1_tgt
,AMOUNT2_tgt
,AMOUNT3_tgt
,AMOUNT4_tgt
,AMOUNT5_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
